rules.name: Fanatical Doctrines
text: Once per turn, at the start of any phase, each SAN'SHYUUM model from your army can issue one Fanatical Doctrine to one friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit within 6" of it. That unit is affected by that Doctrine until the end of the turn. A unit can be affected by one Caste Doctrine and one Fanatical Doctrine at the same time.

**Shielded by Faith:** Models in this unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
**Claim the Sacred Path:** Add 2 to the OC characteristic of models in this unit.
**Wrath of the Prophets:** Weapons equipped by models in this unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

rules.name: Fevered Pilgrimage
text: GRUNT units from your army are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they made an advance move.

rules.name: Devoted
text: Once per battle round, at the start of any phase, each UNGGOY Sergeant model from your army can issue one Fanatical Doctrine to its unit, as well as its Caste Doctrine. That Fanatical Doctrine lasts until the end of the turn.

enhancements.name: Voice of Salvation
text: The bearer can issue Fanatical Doctrines as though it were a SAN'SHYUUM model.

enhancements.name: Icon of the Sacred Path
text: While a friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit is within 6" of the bearer, you can re-roll battle-shock rolls made for it, and while it is within range of an objective marker, the OC characteristic of its models cannot be reduced below 1.

enhancements.name: The Final Sermon
text: Once per battle, when the bearer is destroyed, before removing it, select up to three friendly COVENANT INFANTRY units within 9" of it that are not affected by a Fanatical Doctrine. Each is affected by one Fanatical Doctrine of your choice until the end of the turn.

enhancements.name: Consecrated War Harnesses
text: Improve the Sv and Ld characteristics of UNGGOY models in this unit by 1, to a maximum of 2+ Sv.

stratagems.name: Proclaim the Sacred Path
stratagems.when: Start of any phase, just after a SAN'SHYUUM model from your army issues a Fanatical Doctrine.
stratagems.effect: Select one more friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit within 6" of that model. That unit is also affected by that Doctrine until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Cleanse the Sacred Ground
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a GRUNT unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, improve the AP characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Armoured by Conviction
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a GRUNT unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the AP characteristic of those attacks by 1.

stratagems.name: Martyr's Zeal
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a GRUNT unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, roll one D6. On a 5+, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Living Bulwark
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects an unattached SAN'SHYUUM CHARACTER unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.target: That SAN'SHYUUM unit and one non-CHARACTER GRUNT unit from your army within 3" of it.
stratagems.effect: Each time one of those attacks targets your SAN'SHYUUM unit, if your GRUNT unit is an eligible target for that attack, it targets your GRUNT unit instead.

stratagems.name: Unquestioning Obedience
stratagems.when: Just after a GRUNT unit from your army within 6" of a SAN'SHYUUM model from your army fails a battle-shock roll.
stratagems.effect: Your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds, and that battle-shock roll is treated as passed.

rules.name: Invasion Vessels
text: Spirit, Phantom and Lich units from your army are Invasion Vessels.

rules.name: Drop Assault
text: Each time a unit disembarks from an Invasion Vessel that did not make an ingress move this turn, it can make an Assault Disembark move.

rules.name: Beachhead
text: While a COVENANT INFANTRY unit from your army is within 6" of an Invasion Vessel from your army, add 1 to the OC characteristic of models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Orbital Homing Beacon
text: Once per battle, when an Invasion Vessel from your army makes an ingress move while the bearer is on the battlefield, it can be set up wholly within 9" of the bearer instead of within 6" of a battlefield edge. All other ingress rules still apply.

enhancements.name: Groundside Targeting Beacon
text: At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit visible to the bearer. Until the end of the phase, ranged attacks that target that unit have [IGNORES COVER] if they are made by an Invasion Vessel from your army or by a unit from your army within 6" of one.

enhancements.name: Veteran of the First Wave
text: While the bearer is leading a unit, that unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it made a Rapid Disembark move.

enhancements.name: Flagship Command Throne
text: Each time the bearer uses Shipmaster's Command, select one more friendly COVENANT unit within 6" of the bearer. That unit is also affected by that Doctrine.

stratagems.name: Hot Drop
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just before a unit from your army disembarks from an Invasion Vessel that made an ingress move this turn.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make an Assault Disembark move.

stratagems.name: Gravity-Lift Insertion
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an Invasion Vessel from your army makes an advance move.
stratagems.target: One unit embarked within that Invasion Vessel.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Shock Disembark move from it this phase.

stratagems.name: Strafing Run
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an Invasion Vessel from your army makes a normal or advance move.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit that your unit moved over during that move. Roll six D6 (twelve D6 if your unit is a Lich): for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Return to the Fleet
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One unengaged COVENANT INFANTRY unit from your army with every model within 3" of an Invasion Vessel from your army.
stratagems.effect: If that Invasion Vessel has enough transport capacity, your unit embarks within it, even if your unit disembarked this turn.

stratagems.name: Hold the Beachhead
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a COVENANT INFANTRY unit from your army within 6" of an Invasion Vessel from your army as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the AP characteristic of those attacks by 1.

stratagems.name: Clear the Landing Zone
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Invasion Vessel from your army, or a COVENANT unit from your army within 6" of one, is selected to shoot or fight.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, add 1 to the wound roll.

rules.name: Worthy Foe
text: At the start of each battle round, select one unit from your opponent's army. Until the end of the battle round, that unit is your Worthy Foe.
Each time a model in an ELITE unit from your army makes an attack that targets your Worthy Foe, add 1 to the wound roll.

rules.name: Shields of the Sangheili
text: Each time a SANGHEILI model from your army makes a Shield Save, re-roll a result of 1.
While a unit from your army contains one or more SANGHEILI models, add 1 to battle-shock rolls made for that unit.
Unbroken Discipline: Each time a SANGHEILI Sergeant model from your army issues a Caste Doctrine, that Doctrine lasts until the end of the turn instead of until the end of the phase.

enhancements.name: Blade of the Kaidon
text: Add 1 to the A characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer, and those weapons have [PRECISION].

enhancements.name: Mark of Glory
text: Each time the bearer's unit destroys your Worthy Foe, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Kaidon's Shield Generator
text: While the bearer is leading a unit, each time that unit resolves Regenerating Shields, it regains 2 additional lost SP.

enhancements.name: Hunter's Eye
text: Once per battle, just after your Worthy Foe is destroyed, if the bearer is on the battlefield, select one unit from your opponent's army. Until the end of the battle round, that unit is your Worthy Foe.

stratagems.name: The Killing Stroke
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an ELITE unit from your army is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have [LETHAL HITS], and each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets your Worthy Foe, improve the AP characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Shields Unbroken
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a unit from your army that contains one or more SANGHEILI models as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, Shield Saves made for SANGHEILI models in your unit succeed on a 2+.

stratagems.name: Relentless Pursuit
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ELITE unit from your army makes an advance move.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it made an advance move.

stratagems.name: Honour Duel
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One SANGHEILI CHARACTER unit from your army that is engaged with one or more enemy CHARACTER units.
stratagems.effect: Select one SANGHEILI CHARACTER model in your unit and one CHARACTER model in an enemy unit your unit is engaged with. Until both models have fought or either is destroyed, each can only make melee attacks that target the other's unit, those attacks can only be allocated to the other model, and attacks made by other models cannot be allocated to either of them. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for melee attacks made by your model.

stratagems.name: Death Before Dishonour
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects an ELITE unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove it. After the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, that model can fight, and is then removed.

stratagems.name: Command the Lesser Races
stratagems.when: Start of any phase.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army whose SANGHEILI Sergeant model has already issued a Caste Doctrine this battle round.
stratagems.effect: That Sergeant model can issue one more Caste Doctrine this battle round. If your unit is already affected by a Caste Doctrine, the new Doctrine replaces it.

rules.name: Bloodlust
text: Each time a BRUTE unit from your army makes a charge move, until the end of the turn, add 1 to the A characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

rules.name: Pack Dominance
text: While a unit from your army contains one or more JIRALHANAE models, you can re-roll charge rolls made for that unit.
Alpha's Roar: Each JIRALHANAE Sergeant model from your army can issue one Caste Doctrine in each player's turn, instead of once per battle round.

enhancements.name: Breachmaster's Mantle
text: Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have [ANTI-MONSTER 4+] and [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+].

enhancements.name: Berserker's Rage
text: While the bearer has lost one or more wounds, add 1 to the A and S characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Trophy Standard
text: While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1 to the OC characteristic of models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Howl of the Hunt
text: While the bearer is leading a unit, that unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it made an advance move.

stratagems.name: Pin the Prey
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One unengaged BRUTE INFANTRY or BRUTE MOUNTED unit from your army within 12" of one or more enemy units that ended a normal, advance or fall-back move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Resolve a charge with your unit. When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that ended a normal, advance or fall-back move this phase.

stratagems.name: Crushing Assault
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a BRUTE unit from your army is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the wound roll. If your unit is below its starting strength, also add 1 to the hit roll.

stratagems.name: Unbreakable Hide
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a unit from your army that contains one or more JIRALHANAE models as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack is allocated to a JIRALHANAE model in your unit, worsen the AP characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Hold Them Fast
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit engaged with one or more BRUTE units from your army is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit must make a Desperate Escape test.

stratagems.name: Brutal Momentum
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a BRUTE unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when your unit makes a consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of 3".

stratagems.name: Pack Alpha's Fury
stratagems.when: Start of any phase.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army whose JIRALHANAE Sergeant model has already issued a Caste Doctrine this turn.
stratagems.effect: That Sergeant model can issue one more Caste Doctrine this turn. If your unit is already affected by a Caste Doctrine, the new Doctrine replaces it.

rules.name: Chain of Command
text: Each battle round, each SANGHEILI Sergeant model from your army can issue up to 3 Caste Doctrines, each JIRALHANAE Sergeant model up to 2, and each other Sergeant model 1.

Each Caste Doctrine is issued at the start of any phase, to the Sergeant model's own unit or to one friendly COVENANT unit of any kind (including VEHICLE and MOUNTED units) within 6" of it. That unit is affected by that Doctrine as though it contained that Sergeant model. A unit can still be affected by only one Caste Doctrine at a time.

rules.name: Combined Arms
text: Each unit's designation is its unit keyword: ELITE, BRUTE, GRUNT, JACKAL, DRONE, HUNTER or ENGINEER. VEHICLE and MOUNTED units have the VEHICLE designation instead. An Attached unit has the designations of all its units.
While a unit from your army is within 6" of a friendly unit with a designation it does not have, each time a model in it makes an attack, re-roll a hit roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Hierarch's Mandate
text: While the bearer is leading a unit, that unit's Sergeant model can issue one additional Caste Doctrine each battle round.

enhancements.name: Target Designator
text: At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit visible to the bearer. Until the end of the phase, ranged attacks made by COVENANT VEHICLE units from your army that target that unit have [LETHAL HITS].

enhancements.name: Veteran of Many Worlds
text: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer's unit can be affected by one Caste Doctrine of your choice that can be used in that phase, as though it contained the appropriate Sergeant model.

enhancements.name: Battle Group Marshal
text: Once per battle round, while the bearer is on the battlefield, you can reduce the CP cost of one Stratagem from this detachment by 1CP.

stratagems.name: Coordinated Strike
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a COVENANT VEHICLE unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.target: One enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks, and one COVENANT INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your INFANTRY unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the wound roll.

stratagems.name: Armoured Escort
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a COVENANT INFANTRY unit from your army within 6" of a COVENANT VEHICLE unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, your unit has the benefit of cover.

stratagems.name: Change of Command
stratagems.when: Start of any phase.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army whose Sergeant model has issued all of its Caste Doctrines this battle round.
stratagems.effect: That Sergeant model can issue one additional Caste Doctrine this battle round.

stratagems.name: Focused Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a COVENANT unit from your army is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that was hit by an attack made by another unit from your army this phase, add 1 to the hit roll.

stratagems.name: Shield Relay
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One COVENANT VEHICLE unit from your army with Shields and one COVENANT INFANTRY unit from your army within 6" of it.
stratagems.effect: Your VEHICLE unit loses up to 3 SP. Your INFANTRY unit regains that many lost SP.

stratagems.name: Combined Assault
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a COVENANT VEHICLE or MOUNTED unit from your army ends a charge move.
stratagems.target: One COVENANT INFANTRY unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your INFANTRY unit declares a charge against an enemy unit engaged with that VEHICLE or MOUNTED unit, you can re-roll its charge roll.

rules.name: Plasma Overcharge
text: Each time a COVENANT VEHICLE model from your army makes a ranged attack with a Plasma weapon, an unmodified hit roll of 5+ scores a critical hit.

rules.name: Gravity Drives
text: COVENANT VEHICLE units from your army are eligible to shoot in a turn in which they made an advance or fall-back move. Each time one of those units resolves Regenerating Shields, it regains 1 additional lost SP.

enhancements.name: Armour Commander
text: At the start of your Shooting phase, select one friendly COVENANT VEHICLE unit within 6" of the bearer. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

enhancements.name: Veteran Crew
text: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, you can re-roll the hit roll.

enhancements.name: Overcharged Shield Emitters
enhancements.restriction: Upgrade - COVENANT VEHICLE unit with Shields only.
text: Add 3 to the starting SP of models in this unit.

enhancements.name: Elite Pilot
text: Each time a ranged attack targets this unit, subtract 1 from the hit roll.

stratagems.name: Overcharged Cannons
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a COVENANT VEHICLE unit from your army is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the S and D characteristics of Plasma weapons equipped by models in your unit. After your unit has shot, each model in it loses D3 SP.

stratagems.name: Target Lock
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a COVENANT VEHICLE unit from your army is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit, add 1 to the wound roll.

stratagems.name: Gravity Surge
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an unengaged COVENANT VEHICLE unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Ramming Speed
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a COVENANT VEHICLE unit from your army ends a charge move.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit your unit is engaged with and roll one D6. On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Reinforced Armour
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a COVENANT VEHICLE unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the AP characteristic of those attacks by 1.

stratagems.name: Emergency Shield Reroute
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after the SP of a COVENANT VEHICLE model from your army is reduced to 0.
stratagems.effect: That model regains D3+1 lost SP.

rules.name: Separatists
text: Your army cannot include JIRALHANAE or SAN'SHYUUM models, including Sergeant and Auxiliary models.

rules.name: Freed from the Lie
text: Each time a model in an ELITE unit from your army makes an attack, re-roll a hit roll of 1 and re-roll a wound roll of 1.

rules.name: Brothers in Arms
text: While a GRUNT unit from your army is within 6" of an ELITE unit from your army, each time a model in that GRUNT unit makes an attack, re-roll a hit roll of 1, and add 1 to the OC characteristic of models in that GRUNT unit.

enhancements.name: Blade of Sanghelios
text: Add 1 to the S and D characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Ancestral Armour
text: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save, and add 2 to its starting SP.

enhancements.name: Vow of Vengeance
text: At the start of the battle, select one enemy CHARACTER model. Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets that model's unit, you can re-roll the hit roll and the wound roll.

enhancements.name: Huragok Companion
text: While the bearer is leading a unit, each time that unit resolves Regenerating Shields, it regains 1 additional lost SP.

stratagems.name: For Sanghelios!
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an ELITE unit from your army is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a GRUNT unit from your army within 6" of an ELITE unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the AP characteristic of those attacks by 1.

stratagems.name: Active Camouflage
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects an ELITE INFANTRY unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, models in your unit have the Stealth ability.

stratagems.name: Avenge the Fallen
stratagems.when: Just after an ELITE unit from your army is destroyed.
stratagems.target: The enemy unit that destroyed it.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of your next turn, each time a model in an ELITE unit from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, you can re-roll the hit roll.

stratagems.name: Rally the Swords
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One battle-shocked GRUNT or ELITE unit from your army within 6" of a SANGHEILI CHARACTER model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is no longer battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: Plasma Grenades
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ELITE or GRUNT GRENADES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 8" of and visible to your unit, and roll six D6. For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. Your unit is not eligible to shoot this phase.

rules.name: Pirates of the Void
text: **JACKAL units:** Each time a model in a JACKAL unit from your army makes an attack that targets a unit below its starting strength, you can re-roll the hit roll.
**Opportunists:** Each time a YIG-YAR Sergeant model from your army issues a Caste Doctrine, select two of its Doctrines that can be used in that phase. Its unit is affected by both.

enhancements.name: Raider's Instinct
text: While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Scouts 6" ability.

enhancements.name: Hunter's Lenses
text: Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: Scuttle to Cover
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has finished making attacks against an unengaged JACKAL unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: Pick Them Off
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a JACKAL unit from your army is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have [PRECISION], and each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, add 1 to the wound roll.

stratagems.name: Shield Wall
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a JACKAL INFANTRY unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: The Hive Mind
text: **DRONE units:** DRONE units from your army are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they made an advance or fall-back move.
**Hive Link:** Each time a YANME'E Sergeant model from your army issues a Caste Doctrine, select one other friendly DRONE unit within 12" of it. That unit is also affected by that Doctrine.

enhancements.name: Hive Beacon
text: Once per battle, when a DRONE unit from your army makes an ingress move while the bearer is on the battlefield, it can be set up wholly within 6" of the bearer instead of within 6" of a battlefield edge. All other ingress rules still apply.

enhancements.name: Brood of the Queen
text: Add 1 to the A characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit.

stratagems.name: Endless Hive
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One DRONE unit from your army that is below its starting strength.
stratagems.effect: Up to D3+1 destroyed Yanme'e Drone models are returned to your unit.

stratagems.name: Needler Storm
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a DRONE unit from your army is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Take to the Skies
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One unengaged DRONE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit into strategic reserves.

rules.name: Living Colony
text: **Colony Regeneration:** At the start of your Command phase, each model in a HUNTER unit from your army regains up to D3 lost wounds.
**Hunters of Machines:** Each time a MGALEKGOLO model from your army makes an attack that targets a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit, re-roll a wound roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Elder Colony
text: Add 1 to the A characteristic of weapons equipped by models in this unit.

enhancements.name: Dense Colony
text: Each time an attack targets this unit, if the S characteristic of that attack is greater than the T characteristic of this unit, subtract 1 from the wound roll.

stratagems.name: Bond-Brother's Vengeance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a MGALEKGOLO model from your army is destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Before removing that model, it can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase if it was destroyed in the Shooting phase, or fight if it was destroyed in the Fight phase.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Advance
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a HUNTER unit from your army makes an advance move.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it made an advance move.

stratagems.name: Colony Guardians
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a COVENANT CHARACTER unit from your army within 3" of a HUNTER unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.target: That CHARACTER unit and that HUNTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Each time one of those attacks targets your CHARACTER unit, if your HUNTER unit is an eligible target for that attack, it targets your HUNTER unit instead.

rules.name: Mending the Fleet
text: **ENGINEER units:** Each time an ENGINEER model from your army uses Repair and Refit, it can select a friendly COVENANT unit with Shields within 3" of it instead of a VEHICLE or FORTIFICATION model. That unit regains D3+1 lost SP.
**HURAGOK models:** While a friendly COVENANT unit is within 3" of one or more HURAGOK models from your army, each time it resolves Regenerating Shields, it regains 1 additional lost SP.

enhancements.name: Dual Repair Protocols
text: The bearer can use Repair and Refit twice per turn, selecting a different model or unit each time.

enhancements.name: Huragok-Tended Systems
text: Each time this unit resolves Regenerating Shields, it regains 1 additional lost SP.

stratagems.name: Emergency Restoration
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has finished making attacks against a COVENANT unit from your army within 6" of an ENGINEER model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Your unit regains D3 lost SP.

stratagems.name: Harmonised Shields
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a COVENANT unit from your army within 6" of an ENGINEER model from your army as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, Shield Saves made for models in your unit succeed on a 2+.

stratagems.name: Overcharged Systems
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a COVENANT VEHICLE unit from your army within 6" of an ENGINEER model from your army is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for ranged attacks made by models in your unit. After your unit has shot, each model in it loses D3 SP.

rules.name: Strength in Numbers
text: **GRUNT units:** While a GRUNT unit from your army contains 10 or more models, add 1 to the A characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit.
**Mob Mentality:** Each time an UNGGOY Sergeant model from your army issues a Caste Doctrine, every other friendly GRUNT unit within 6" of it is also affected by that Doctrine.

enhancements.name: Rallying Sermon
text: While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1 to the OC characteristic of models in that unit, and you can re-roll battle-shock rolls made for it.

enhancements.name: Grenadier Cadre
text: Once per battle round, when this unit is selected to shoot, select one enemy unit within 8" of and visible to it, and roll six D6. For each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Expendable Screen
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a non-GRUNT COVENANT INFANTRY unit from your army within 3" of a GRUNT unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.target: That INFANTRY unit and that GRUNT unit.
stratagems.effect: Each time one of those attacks targets your INFANTRY unit, if your GRUNT unit is an eligible target for that attack, it targets your GRUNT unit instead.

stratagems.name: Reinforce the Levy
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Grunt Cadre unit from your army that is below its starting strength.
stratagems.effect: Up to D3+2 destroyed Unggoy Warrior models are returned to your unit.

stratagems.name: Grenade Rush
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a GRUNT unit from your army ends a charge move.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit your unit is engaged with, and roll one D6 for each model in your unit, to a maximum of 10. For each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

rules.name: Striding Siege
text: **WALKER units:** COVENANT WALKER units from your army are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they made an advance move, and they can move over terrain features 4" or less in height as though they were not there.
**Siege Weapons:** Ranged weapons equipped by COVENANT WALKER models from your army have [IGNORES COVER].

enhancements.name: Siege Coordinator
text: At the start of your Shooting phase, select one friendly COVENANT WALKER unit within 6" of the bearer. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to wound rolls for ranged attacks made by models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Stabilised Platform
text: If this unit remained stationary this turn, add 1 to the A characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit.

stratagems.name: Crushing Stride
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a COVENANT WALKER unit from your army makes a normal or advance move.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy INFANTRY unit within 3" of your unit, and roll six D6. For each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Siege Stance
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a COVENANT WALKER unit from your army that remained stationary this turn is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Overshield Projectors
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a COVENANT WALKER unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time one of those attacks targets your unit, if its S characteristic is greater than the T characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the wound roll.

rules.name: Wrath of the Hierarchs
text: **TITANIC units:** COVENANT TITANIC models from your army ignore the hit-roll penalty of their Damaged ability, and each time one of them makes an attack, re-roll a hit roll of 1.
**Titan Shields:** Each time a COVENANT TITANIC unit from your army resolves Regenerating Shields, it regains D3 additional lost SP.

enhancements.name: Holy Gunnery Crew
text: Each time this unit is selected to shoot, select one ranged weapon equipped by a model in it. Until the end of the phase, you can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made with that weapon.

enhancements.name: Shield Amplifier Array
enhancements.restriction: Upgrade - COVENANT TITANIC unit with Shields only.
text: Add 4 to the starting SP of models in this unit.

stratagems.name: Glassing Strike
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a COVENANT TITANIC unit from your army is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Behemoth
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an engaged COVENANT TITANIC unit from your army is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it made a fall-back move.

stratagems.name: Emergency Shield Surge
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after the SP of a COVENANT TITANIC model from your army is reduced to 0.
stratagems.effect: That model regains D6 lost SP.

rules.name: Shadow War
text: SPECIAL OPERATIONS, RANGER, ASSASSIN and BLADEMASTER units from your army are Spec Ops units.
**Spec Ops units:** Models in Spec Ops units from your army have the Stealth ability.

**Every Blade a Shadowmaster:** Once per battle round, at the start of any phase, each Spec Ops INFANTRY unit from your army can issue one Sangheili Special Operations Doctrine to itself, as though it contained a Shadowmaster.

enhancements.name: Silent Blade
text: Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have [PRECISION] and [LETHAL HITS].

enhancements.name: Advanced Active Camouflage
enhancements.restriction: Upgrade - SPECIAL OPERATIONS, RANGER or ASSASSIN INFANTRY unit only.
text: Each time a ranged attack targets this unit, subtract 1 from the hit roll.

stratagems.name: Booby Trap
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One enemy unit within 6" of a Spec Ops unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6. On a 3+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Vanish
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One unengaged Spec Ops INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit into strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: Decapitate
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a Spec Ops unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have [PRECISION], and each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, add 1 to the wound roll.

rules.name: The Hierarchs' Will
text: **SAN'SHYUUM models:** Add 3" to the range of abilities of SAN'SHYUUM models from your army.

**Sworn Protectors:** While an HONOR GUARD or ENTOURAGE unit from your army contains a CHARACTER model, add 1 to the A characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit, and its models have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

enhancements.name: Gravity Throne Shield
text: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save and a starting SP of 3.

enhancements.name: Ceremonial Energy Staves
text: Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: Protect the Hierarch
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects an unattached SAN'SHYUUM CHARACTER unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.target: That SAN'SHYUUM unit and one HONOR GUARD or ENTOURAGE unit from your army within 3" of it.
stratagems.effect: Each time one of those attacks targets your SAN'SHYUUM unit, if your HONOR GUARD or ENTOURAGE unit is an eligible target for that attack, it targets that unit instead.

stratagems.name: Holy Decree
stratagems.when: Start of any phase.
stratagems.target: One SAN'SHYUUM model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one friendly COVENANT unit within 12" of that model and one Caste Doctrine that can be used in that phase. Until the end of the phase, that unit is affected by that Doctrine.

stratagems.name: Divine Retribution
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an HONOR GUARD or ENTOURAGE unit from your army within 6" of a SAN'SHYUUM CHARACTER model from your army is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the hit roll and add 1 to the wound roll.

rules.name: Masters of the Sky
text: Banshee, Vampire and Seraph units from your army are Fleet Aviation units.
**Air Superiority:** Each time a model in a Fleet Aviation unit from your army makes a ranged attack, re-roll a hit roll of 1. If the target has the FLY keyword, you can re-roll the hit roll instead.
**Strike and Withdraw:** After a Fleet Aviation unit from your army has shot, if it is unengaged, it can make a normal move of up to 6".

enhancements.name: Ace Pilot
enhancements.restriction: Upgrade - Banshee, Vampire or Seraph unit only.
text: Improve the BS characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

enhancements.name: Fuel Rod Payload
enhancements.restriction: Upgrade - Banshee, Vampire or Seraph unit only.
text: Once per battle, after this unit makes a normal move, select one enemy unit it moved over during that move and roll one D6. On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Strafing Pass
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a Fleet Aviation unit from your army is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit without the FLY keyword, that attack has [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Dogfight
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a Fleet Aviation unit from your army is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit with the FLY keyword, add 1 to the wound roll.

stratagems.name: Return to the Carrier
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's turn.
stratagems.target: One Fleet Aviation unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit into strategic reserves. Each model in it regains all of its lost SP.

rules.name: Lances of the Covenant
text: **MOUNTED units:** COVENANT MOUNTED units from your army are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they made an advance or fall-back move.
**Splatter:** Each time a COVENANT MOUNTED unit from your army ends a charge move, select one enemy unit it is engaged with and roll one D6. On a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Veteran Riders
text: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a hit roll of 1. Add 1 to the OC characteristic of models in this unit.

enhancements.name: Boosted Thrusters
text: Add 2" to the M characteristic of models in this unit. Each time this unit makes an advance move, do not make an advance roll; add 6" instead.

stratagems.name: Ride Them Down
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a COVENANT MOUNTED unit from your army that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the wound roll.

stratagems.name: Hit and Fade
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an unengaged COVENANT MOUNTED unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6". It is not eligible to declare a charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Evasive Boost
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a COVENANT MOUNTED unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, subtract 1 from the hit rolls for those attacks.
